name: How does a luxury buyer's agent differ from a standard real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: How does a luxury buyer's agent differ from a standard real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury buyer's agent specializes in the unique demands of high-value property transactions, often possessing a deeper understanding of high-end amenities, construction quality, and market trends specific to luxury locales. Unlike standard agents who may work with a broader range of properties, a luxury agent focuses on discretion, personalized service, and access to off-market listings frequently found in areas such as Miami Beach or Coral Gables. This specialized focus provides a practical tradeoff, offering more targeted expertise in exchange for a narrower client base.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury buyer's agent specializes in high-value property transactions, offering deeper market knowledge, discretion, and access to exclusive listings often not available to standard agents.
